## Testing Mode

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: fix-bug shell-script fix emits "Antipattern-Scan: <query> root=<scan-root> matches=<n>" commit trailer from anti-pattern-scan.md SCAN_RESULT trailer_line, copied verbatim into the commit message. (verbatim-copy evidence half; source-field half owned by task-1.)
- dd-4: Phase G promote-query sub-step appends query to known-antipatterns.yaml per 7575-5a90 schema when file exists, else writes durable "ANTIPATTERN_PROMOTE_DEFERRED: <query>" ticket comment. (Registry NOT shipped → deferred path active.)

Edit plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md Phase G to (a) copy the SCAN_RESULT trailer_line VERBATIM into the commit message (the dd-1 emission path), and (b) add the promote-query sub-step: when known-antipatterns.yaml exists, append the query per the 7575-5a90 schema; otherwise write a durable 'ANTIPATTERN_PROMOTE_DEFERRED: <query>' ticket comment (the registry is not shipped, so the deferred path is the active path). SKILL.md MUST instruct VERBATIM copy of trailer_line.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) — Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0) — Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0) — Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] dd-1 evidence: Phase G instructs VERBATIM copy of trailer_line into the commit message — Verify: awk '/^## Phase G/{p=1} /^## Phase H/{p=0} p' plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md | grep -A2 'trailer_line' | grep -qi verbatim
- [ ] dd-4: promote-query appends to known-antipatterns.yaml when present — Verify: awk '/^## Phase G/{p=1} /^## Phase H/{p=0} p' plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md | grep -q 'known-antipatterns.yaml'
- [ ] dd-4: deferred path writes the exact ANTIPATTERN_PROMOTE_DEFERRED comment — Verify: awk '/^## Phase G/{p=1} /^## Phase H/{p=0} p' plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md | grep -qE 'ANTIPATTERN_PROMOTE_DEFERRED: <query>'
- [ ] dd-4: the 7575-5a90 schema is referenced for the append — Verify: awk '/^## Phase G/{p=1} /^## Phase H/{p=0} p' plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md | grep -q '7575-5a90'
- [ ] TDD exemption: Rule 5 (behavioral-testing-standard) — instruction-file SKILL.md wiring; structural sequence ACs are the accepted standard. Verify: test -f plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/behavioral-testing-standard.md
- [ ] Phase G instructs the trailer_line copy as a git trailer in the commit-message footer (key: value, blank-line-separated). Verify: awk '/^#+ *Phase G/{p=1} /^#+ *Phase H/{p=0} p' plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md | grep -iqE 'trailer.*(footer|key.*value|git[ -]trailer)'

MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
